lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: solving applied problems with similar figures

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow; a tree casts a 12 m shadow. Tree height?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².
The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.
The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 6 corresponds to DE = 12. If BC = 2, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 12 and 432. Find the altitude.
A 8 m pole casts a 8 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 72 m shadow. How tall is the building?
choices: 9 m

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.
This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 11 corresponds to DE = 55. If BC = 18, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 5 and 45. Find the altitude.
A 7 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 25 m shadow. How tall is the building?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.
